title: Van's Shop (DS)
wikitext:
{{InfoNeeded}}
'''Van's Shop''' is a small shop set up by [[Van (DS)|Van]] on top of an orange crate on the top floor of the [[Inner Inn (DS)|Inner Inn]]. He comes into town on the 3rd, 8th, 13th, 18th, 23rd, and 28th days of the season to open his shop.
